en: A vintage black‑and‑white romantic postcard showing a young couple in early 20th‑century clothing. The man in a dark suit and tie gently holds both hands of a woman wearing a light-colored dress with puffed sleeves and a long skirt. They look at each other intimately. At the top there is a printed Spanish verse, and at the bottom appears a small credit line to the Biblioteca Regional de Madrid along with a circular logo and the number 509/1.
